decisions.decision: The committee set a public hearing on the Warrant for November 14, 2021, and Special Town Meeting for November 16, 2021.
decisions.quote: the committee will hold a public hearing on the warrant on november 14, 2021. special town meeting will be held on november 16, 2021.

decisions.decision: Next committee meetings set for September 9 and September 23, 2021.

budget_items.topic: Town revenue versus expectations (FY21 year end)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Accountant reported revenues exceeded expectations by 2.2 percent for the year.
budget_items.quote: said the town had a very good year with revenues exceeding expectations by 2.2 percent.

budget_items.topic: Unused levy capacity in prior years
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Accountant said there were years the town did not levy to capacity, and that changes can be made at Annual Town Meeting.
budget_items.quote: ms. brochu added that there were a number of years when the town didn't levy to capacity

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A member asked when decisions would be made on ARPA funds; the Town Accountant said projects must be checked against U.S. Treasury guidelines.
budget_items.quote: mr. menard asked when decisions would be made pertaining to arpa funds.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Fire Chief plans to hire another full-time staff person next year, will not request a new truck until 2027, and suggested using ARPA funds to replace an aging rescue vehicle.
budget_items.quote: has suggested using arpa funds to replace an aging rescue vehicle

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Fire Chief said the public safety building has mold and drafty-window problems and that the cost of fixing them is unknown.
budget_items.quote: mr. sullivan said he doesn't know what the cost would be to fix the issues.

budget_items.topic: Council on Aging outdoor area grant
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The COA Director is looking into a grant to start work on the back outdoor area of the senior center.
budget_items.quote: she is looking into a $20,000 grant to get started

budget_items.topic: Cares Act and Formula Grant funds at senior center
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The COA Director used carried-over Formula Grant funds, donations and fundraising rather than Cares Act funds, and used existing funds for a projector and sound system.
budget_items.quote: ms. doherty answered that since she was able to carry over formula grant funds this year

topics.quote: peter beardmore called the meeting to order at 7:01 p.m. and read a statement

ms. doherty informed the committee that the senior center is getting back to normal
